name: clevelandart
description: Cleveland Museum of Art online collection: search and filter artworks (keyword, artist, culture, type, medium, department, gallery, on view, recent acquisitions), autocomplete collection terms, get artwork details, related artworks, gallery locations and deep-zoom image info.

commands.name: search-artworks
commands.summary: Search the CMA collection by keyword, with optional filters (type, department, artist, culture, on view, recently acquired), paged by offset

params.name: q
params.description: Keyword search: artist, title, subject or accession number. Leave empty to browse the whole collection.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Page size (sent to the API as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: type
params.description: Artwork type, e.g. Painting, Print, Drawing, Sculpture, Photograph

params.name: department
params.description: Curatorial department, e.g. 'American Painting and Sculpture', 'Modern European Painting and Sculpture'

params.name: currently_on_view
params.description: Only artworks currently on view in the galleries

commands.name: get-artwork
commands.summary: Get full details of one artwork by accession number (title, date, artist, culture, medium, measurements, credit line, description, provenance, images)

commands.name: list-related-artworks
commands.summary: List the 'See Also' related artworks shown on an artwork's detail page

commands.name: list-gallery-locations
commands.summary: List the museum's gallery locations (values accepted by the gallery= filter of search-artworks)

commands.name: get-image-zoom-info
commands.summary: Get deep-zoom (DZI) metadata for an artwork image: full pixel width/height, tile size and format

params.name: image_id
params.description: Hex image id from the artwork's zoomify/DZI URL in get-artwork data

notes: search-artworks wraps the site's nested queryString API. All filters go in --filters as an &-joined 'key=value' string, e.g. 'currently_on_view=1&type=Painting&orderby=date_sortable desc'.

Filter keys seen: currently_on_view=1, recently_acquired=1, artist_tags (e.g. female), artists, type, culture, medium, credit, gallery, department, collection_mapped, orderby (date_sortable asc|desc). Facet values are the exact display strings shown on artwork pages, e.g. culture=United States, type=Painting.
Use the exact values from the detail page or from suggest-collection. suggest-collection with --filter artists returns artist names suitable for artists=.
info.total in the raw search response gives the total hit count. Page with --skip in steps of 100.
Artwork detail URLs are https://www.clevelandart.org/art/{accession_number}. A printable view is at /print/art/{accession_number}.
Only public, read-only collection data is covered. The ticketing, cart and tracking-pixel endpoints were skipped.
